1.0: Gosh... #bSpiruna#k's precious#b Black Crystal#k looks terrible. I understand how you feel, but no words will make Spiruna feel better at the moment.

npc.0: How dare you speak to me! How could you crack my precious Crystal? Argh, how will I fix this...? Will my assistant know...?

0.0: What's this? My... Black Crystal is cracked...! Why, that...! She borrows my Crystal and cracks it?! And you think I'll let you get away with dumping this on me?! Both of you are in BIG trouble!
0.1: Ugh, I need to fix this Crystal... Should I ask my assistant?

QuestInfo.name: Restoring the Crystal
QuestInfo.1: Spiruna's just furious about the Cracked Black Crystal. Maybe the woman who lives with Spiruna will help?
QuestInfo.2: Spiruna is pitching a fit. What to do? The lady next to her seems to be calm... Maybe she has an idea?
QuestInfo.summary: Talk to the mysterious girl who lives with Spiruna.
QuestInfo.0: Spiruna is unthrilled about the smashed Black Crystal. You still have to ask her about Hella, though...
